insights.summary: The agent successfully optimized the codebase by addressing memory allocation patterns and Python object overhead. It followed the instructions precisely and met all iteration and constraint requirements.

Clean and correct implementation of Python-specific optimizations (slots).

Relatively shallow exploration of the mathematical/algorithmic logic in the sampler.
